decisions.decision_value: Palm-conforming double-curved rubber remote with finger-aligned buttons (thumb=power, index=channel up, middle=channel down, ring=volume up, pinkie=volume down, plus lock, mute, and top keypad) and kinetic power at 10.70 Euros unit production cost
decisions.rationale: Eliminates repetitive wrist and thumb strain (anti-RSI) by placing each primary button directly under a separate finger while keeping production cost at 10.70 Euros (under the 12.50 Euro limit)
